headline: Romania's Electrica 9-Month Net Profit Falls 4.6%
summary: Romanian power distribution group Electrica reported a 4.6% year-on-year drop in net profit for the first nine months of 2026.
why: Electrica is a major utility operator listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange.

impacts.why: Company posted a 4.6% decline in nine-month net earnings.
